reviewMethod: Official eCode360 ordinance PDFs are checksum-verified headlessly. When eCode360 re-issues a PDF with new bytes, the check passes only if every decoded page-content and image stream is identical to the receipted copy (contentStreamsSha256); any content change fails. Current chapter pages return HTTP 403 to direct clients; the monthly semantic review reads them with headless Chromium from a Claude cloud session (or Parallel AI) and checks City Clerk records and Council agendas for new ordinances. 2026-10-10 review: no ordinance after 1733; Ords. 1731 and 1732 are now codified, and the codified §7.25.130(C)(2) is front yard only.
